newsitem.title: USA: Envirometrics to buy Intellisource unit.
newsitem.headline: Envirometrics to buy Intellisource unit.

text.p: Envirometrics Inc said Friday it signed letter of intent to acquire all of the outstanding stock of Employee Management Solutions Inc (EMS).
EMS is a unit of Intellisource Inc, which is owned by OSG Inc.
In a separate deal, Envirometrics said it agreed to buy the assets and liabilities of Employee Resource Management Inc, which provides human resource outsourcing services.
The purchase will be made through an exchange of stock and is subject to approval of the boards of directors of both companies. Specific terms were not disclosed.
The combined companies will have estimated gross revenues of about $40 million in 1996.

Envirometrics, an environmental health and safety company based in South Carolina, said it also expected to enter a multiyear deal with Intellisource to provide support for its information systems, including financial, marketing, sales and service support.
